Always-expanded note

This fixture exercises all seven sub-slice-2 elements end-to-end. The test asserts each renders as a real custom (or HTML-native) element with its content — no data-enscribe-unknown spans remain. Closed- child-set / parent-child structural validation is a spec concern only; the parser does not enforce it (always-renders posture).

(Note on the open form: the kwarg form open=true is used here rather than the +open boolean form because of a pre-existing limitation in buildProperties — it does not iterate node.booleans, so +flag markers silently drop through the schema dispatch. The limitation is filed as a [post-alpha] backlog item for a future fix; this slice does not address it. Once fixed, +open will render identically to open=true.)
